name: tests-half-dskit-atomic-multi-key-kv-transactions
instr:
dskit lacks portable atomic multi-key transactions. Add them to `github.com/grafana/dskit/kv` through `Client.Transact`, with consistent semantics across Consul, etcd, memberlist, PrefixClient, MultiClient, metrics, reads, and watches, without changing existing non-transactional behavior or exposing partial state or backend details during safe retries and recovery.

Validate each nonempty ordered `Transaction` before storage access, reject duplicate mutation keys, and apply each `Mutation` at most once. Evaluate all `Condition` values against one decoded pre-commit view. Report every conflicting logical key deterministically and expose no mutation on conflict. Consul also supports `ConditionModifyIndex`, with `Value` as the expected ModifyIndex.

Consul, etcd, and memberlist must publish successful transactions as one atomic, merge-safe change. Limits, comparison failures, transport failures, and concurrent changes must not leak partial writes. The etcd Client commits every mutation when declared conditions pass. A failed version comparison returns a portable conflicted outcome with unchanged decoded values; a transport error returns `TransactionError`, not a committed outcome.

Completed identifiers return their original portable `TransactionResult`. Cancellation after durable preparation returns `TransactionError` with `ID`, `Status`, and `Err` until recovery durably commits or aborts. PrefixClient preserves identifiers and restores caller-supplied keys. MultiClient resolve
